title: Extended Storage
description: A mod adds 6 tiers of chests — Wood, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Debris, Netherite
body:
Extended Storage adds 6 tiers of chests — Wood, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Debris, Netherite — each with progressively larger capacity, along with a complete upgrade system.

### 📦 Features

- **6 Chest Tiers:** Wood → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Debris → Netherite
- **15 Upgrade Templates:** Upgrade any chest tier to any higher tier
- **In-World Upgrading:** Sneak + right-click a chest with an upgrade template to upgrade it without losing contents (powered by JsonMore)

### 🔧 Crafting System

- Direct upgrades (adjacent tiers, base material preserved)
- Skip-level upgrades (jump multiple tiers using intermediate templates)
- Combine 2 lower upgrade templates into a higher one

### 📋 Chest Capacities

| Tier | Slots |
|------|-------|
| Wooden | 27 |
| Iron | 54 |
| Golden | 81 |
| Diamond | 108 |
| Debris | 117 |
| Netherite | 135 |

### 📌 Dependencies

- **[CyclopsCore](https://modrinth.com/project/Z9DM0LJ4)** (required)
- **[JsonThings](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/json-things)** (required)
- **[JsonMore](https://github.com/Qikahome/JsonMore)** (already bundled in the jar, no need to install separately)
